testContracts.oracle: Independent expected word strings, message line/null sequence and screen positions; specific grammar diagnostic substrings.
testContracts.dedupe: New external SLF grammar, not duplicate legacy fixed-byte WORD/M.MSG codecs.

testContracts.legalInputs: Typed common Command[] and complete generated 565-word legal Win table, synthetic independent SLF group/revision data.
testContracts.oracle: Literal intended translated group end and line queue, unchanged Chinese command identity, exact failure contracts for fingerprint/prevalues/coverage/translation.
testContracts.dedupe: Tests language assembly/range completeness, distinct from parser syntax and runtime consumer behavior.

testContracts.legalInputs: Existing buildSssArchive fixture declares message length9 and receives exact HELLO MSG9 bytes; complete legal tail pipeline; faithful source-audit mode.
testContracts.oracle: Process exit0, languages.json exactly zh-CN, en.json absent. Expected fixture-only missing-BDF warning is asserted explicitly, not presented as production clean runtime.
testContracts.dedupe: Availability/output wiring is a new contract; does not reassert every codec/table output.

testContracts.publicCaller: real cli.ts main process with supported original Win SSS/M.MSG/WORD input
testContracts.legalInputs: Original supported local raw data + malformed/unreviewed/missing optional English source. Original resource dependency is explicit .pal.test partition, no skip added.
testContracts.oracle: Diagnostic from English preflight, exit1, previous exact sentinel bytes retained and no new events/all.json.
testContracts.dedupe: Owns language preflight-before-cleanup; existing cli-script-corrections.pal.test owns script source/old-value/faithful correction behavior.
